articles.summary: Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR) today announced that its 2026 charity event raised approximately $1.6 million for Blood Cancer United. This marks the 20th year of the Builders FirstSource partnership with Blood Cancer United, which has helped raise more than $19 million for critical research, patient support, and advocacy programs dedicated to advancing treatments and cures for blood cancers over those two decades. Held Sept. 30-Oct. 1 in Irving, Texas, the event featured a keynote speech by Pro Football Hall of Fame linebacker Mike Singletary, who shared inspirational anecdotes from his childhood in Houston, Texas, and his career as an NFL player and coach. Attendees also heard the emotional story of four-year-old cancer patient “Mighty Mabel” Manthey, as told by her mother, Sarah. articles.title: Builders FirstSource Annual Charity Event Raises $1.6 Million for Blood Cancer United

articles.summary: Builders FirstSource, Inc. (NYSE: BLDR) today reported its results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights All Year-Over-Year Comparisons Unless Otherwise Noted: Net sales were $3.9 billion, a decrease of 2.2%, primarily due to a lower housing starts environment and related headwinds. The decline reflects lower core organic net sales as well as commodity deflation, partially offset by growth from acquisitions. Gross profit was $1.1 billion, a decrease of 10.6%. Gross profit margin percentage decreased 260 basis points to 27.8%, primarily driven by a lower housing starts environment and related headwinds. Net income was $60.4 million, or diluted EPS of $0.56 compared to diluted EPS of $1.10 in the prior year period. Net income as a percent of net sales decreased by 150 basis points to 1.6%. articles.title: Builders FirstSource Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Builders FirstSource, Inc. (NYSE: BLDR) (“Builders FirstSource” or the "Company") will host a conference call and webcast on Thursday, October 29, 2026, to discuss the Company’s financial results and other business matters. The teleconference will begin at 8:00 a.m. Central Time and will be hosted by Peter Jackson, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Pete Beckmann, Chief Financial Officer. The live webcast, archived replay, and the accompanying presentation can be accessed on the Company's investor relations website at investors.bldr.com under the Events and Presentations section. The online archive of the webcast will be available for approximately 90 days. To participate in the teleconference, please dial into the call a few minutes before the start time at 800-420-1459 (U.S. and Canada) or 203-518-9861 (International), Conference ID: BLDRQ326.
